question: Do five pending broader clinical FAPI studies contain authenticated EMC identity-to-scan measurements that could establish a new useful within-patient FAPI/FDG imaging contrast?
prior_art: Broad tumor/sarcoma FAPI uptake and aggregate FDG comparisons already published. R5 found no authenticated eligible EMC pair and shelved standalone paper; this source continuation does not revive it.
eligibility: Author-labelled extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma tracked separately from molecular confirmation; generic sarcoma/chondrosarcoma unresolved. Every eligible EMC donor, lesion, repeat scan and condition evaluated; no convenience sampling.
paired_gate: Same patient and lesion; FAPI/FDG scans <=28 days, no intervening therapy; compare tracer/acquisition timing, lesion verification, treatment/scarring. Unchanged R5 gate.
defeaters: No patient/lesion crosswalk or incompatible acquisition
No independence or useful novelty beyond original report
stop: At 25 min assess source availability/EMC eligibility/value; finish feasible discriminating checks rather than collect favorable examples. Pending suitable accessible source prevents advancement.
budget: No paid/GPU/outreach/publication/PR; >=10GiB free; task-scoped sparse tree; preserve originals/copies, no cleanup. Quiet API/file only; UI/screenshots/browser/headless banned 06:00–10:00 America/New_York DST-aware.
restricted_exclusions: No FAP tissue or interrupted FAP-tissue/glycan/structural-genomics/HLA-review content, no bypass. TMEM266 remains shelved.
scientific_duties: Complete all identifiable relevant public EMC evidence; validity AND value reassessment; no tumor-cell localization, dependency, efficacy, safety or dosimetry inference from uptake; donor overlap must be resolved or uncertain.
